title: SVILAPP — partner programme / possible complementary agency relationship

economics.evidence: The official page describes a six-month partner contract with quantitative objectives and compensation terms agreed in the contract; it publishes no buyer budget or guaranteed workload.

reasons: Official current partner page and organization-owned contact route
Strong service overlap with WordPress/WooCommerce, JavaScript, UX/UI, web development and maintenance
Programme accepts freelancers and agencies with VAT registration across Italy
material_gaps: The published programme positions SVILAPP as the technical supplier to partners, not as a buyer of VDS overflow capacity
The partner is expected to maintain the client/commercial relationship and work toward quantitative objectives, indicating a reseller/referral model
No current outsourcing, subcontractor, overflow or external-production demand from SVILAPP is evidenced
No public budget, deadline or purchasable assignment is published

decision.reason: The one permitted bounded research pass found no independent buyer-side outsourcing or overflow demand. The official programme is a supplier/reseller arrangement in which SVILAPP provides technical delivery while the partner brings and manages clients.

next_action.reason: Do not contact from this signal. Reopen only on a materially new official buyer-side need.

outcome.learning_note: Do not treat supplier/reseller partner pages as buyer demand.
outcome.evidence: Official partner and contact pages reverified 2026-10-14.

notes: Verified 2026-10-13 on SVILAPP official partner and contact pages.

Canonical organization/opportunity search, global exact-email/domain/organization ledger, reservations, Hostinger Sent exact/domain/organization checks and curated Gmail Sent ledger found no prior commercial contact.
The only Hostinger Sent match was an owner daily report that mentioned SVILAPP; it is administrative evidence, not a commercial contact.
No external message was sent; the cycle was outside the authorized sending window.
Bounded WAIT_RESEARCH attempt exhausted on 2026-10-14; no buyer-side demand found. Final outcome changed to REJECT.
